properties.description: RocksDB stores written, closed, and reopened. With fulltext/ deleted, the word is found, `searched` counts every searchable node, and search_rebuilt_on_open reports 0 indexed before; an index in step is not rebuilt; a true miss names the population searched. Engine unit tests in crates/reflow2-core/src/foundation/store/engine/fulltext_tests.rs pin the floor: an index that loses the store's documents refuses an empty answer, naming both counts, until rebuilt.
properties.findings: 3 passing (plus 2 engine unit tests). Not runnable on main: the API it reads (searched, search_rebuilt_on_open) is new; the behaviour it pins was measured on main through the door test.
properties.name: A store opened without a search index that covers it rebuilds it, says so, and a search from an index that does not cover its store never answers "nothing matched"
